name: Art Colony Camp
description_short: Five day art camps at the Florence Griswold Museum in Old Lyme, 10 am to 3 pm, with separate weeks for children entering grades 1 to 3 and 4 to 6. Campers explore the museum's exhibitions and the history of the Lyme Art Colony, paint and play games, and each week ends with an art show for families.
refund_policy_summary: Cancellations before each session's cutoff date (about two weeks before camp) are refunded less a $20 fee. No refunds after the cutoff.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Art Colony Camp #1 2026 event page. $385 per five day week, members get 10% off. Fee includes a t-shirt, art materials and daily snacks. Students must have finished kindergarten. Early drop off after 9 am can be arranged by email.

Researched by Claude from this page. Museum camp calendar for July 2026, which links each session's page (art-colony-camp-1-2026 to art-colony-camp-6-2026, each Monday to Friday). Grade ranges and $385 price per session were read on each session page.
